record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The units in appliesTo declare SILVER_WIND in this production reference. The strategy is shared; differences are star count (damage), max HP, maxPP, range and the entity's stats.
record.summary: The caster first buffs itself permanently-for-the-fight by +1 attack, +1 defense, +1 special defense, +10 speed and +10 ability power (all with apBoost 0 and no crit, so not AP-scaled), then dashes to the destination returned by Board.getFarthestTargetCoordinateAvailablePlace and deals SPECIAL damage (raw 20/40/80/160 by caster stars; the listed units: BEAUTIFLY 3 stars -> 80, MASQUERAIN 2 stars -> 40) once to every enemy on the line of cells between its starting cell and that destination. The destination is not guaranteed to be next to the farthest enemy (the helper can retain a cell chosen for an earlier, nearer enemy; see positionalConditions). If the line holds no enemy, or the helper returns null (the caster then does not move), only the cast target is hit. Order matters: the buffs are applied before the damage, so the +10 AP already counts in the damage multiplier x(1 + AP/100) read from the caster by handleSpecialDamage. Requested buff amounts are +1/+1/+1/+10/+10; applied amounts: Big Eater Belt on the caster multiplies each positive value by 1.25 rounded down (1 stays 1, 10 becomes 12; for AP the 10 is rounded first, then belt); Twist Band does nothing to positive self-buffs; NULLIFY_BANDANNA turns the AP gain into addAttack(round(0.2 x 10) = 2) (which the belt can scale); speed is clamped to 0..300; a MELMETAL-passive caster would turn the speed into half attack (not a listed unit). Damage is requested raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], then the target's special defense division (ceil, min 1) and shield handling inside handleDamage (the returned takenDamage includes shield damage).

targeting.who: self (buffs and dash); every enemy on the dashed line (damage); the cast target if the line holds no enemy or no destination exists
targeting.note: requiresTarget stays true (default), so the cast needs a target; it is the guaranteed fallback victim.

geometry.shape: line (supercover) from the caster's starting cell to the destination cell chosen by the helper (not necessarily next to the farthest enemy), both endpoints included; the destination is a free cell; the cells are read before the caster moves

effects.scaling: apBoost 0 and crit false for all five calls, so no AP / crit scaling; Math.round of the unscaled value; then Big Eater Belt (positive value x1.25, rounded down to 0 digits), Twist Band (positive: unchanged). addAbilityPower first checks NULLIFY_BANDANNA and, if held, adds Math.round(0.2 x 10) = 2 attack (addAttack, apBoost 0) instead of AP; addSpeed with the MELMETAL passive adds 0.5 x value attack instead of speed
effects.resolution: applied: atk = min(1)(atk + v), def / speDef = min(0)(... + v), speed = clamp(speed + v, 0, MAX_SPEED = 300), ap = min(-100)(ap + v); stat buffs for the current fight only (permanent false). Applied before the damage step, so the +10 AP (or its Bandanna / Belt variants) is already in effect when damage is computed.

effects.target: each enemy on the cells between the caster and the destination

declaredRaw.label: raw special damage by caster stars

effects.scaling: requested = raw x (1 + caster AP/100) where the caster AP already includes the +10 added earlier in the same cast; x crit factor (1 + (critPower - 1) x the target's crit reduction) only if the cast rolled a crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false); then the target's special-defense division (reducedDamage = damage / (1 + 0.05 x speDef)), ceil, at least 1
effects.resolution: applied: handleSpecialDamage is blocked by protect / skydiving / magicBounce on the target; otherwise handleDamage applies shields and the special-defense division; takenDamage includes shield damage; each enemy is hit once (a Set); the strategy ignores the returned values.
moveTo(x, y, board, false) to the destination; if the helper returns null the caster stays where it is.

starBehavior.note: only the damage depends on stars; the five buffs are fixed. 1-star (20) and 4+-star (160) values are not reachable by the listed units' bare factory stars. maxPP and range differ: BEAUTIFLY 60 / 1, MASQUERAIN 100 / 2.

record.positionalConditions: Selection in board.ts:568-630 (same helper as NUZZLE and AQUA_JET): board.forEach scans cells row by row (y outer, x inner); only targettable enemies whose Manhattan distance from the caster is STRICTLY greater than the running maximum are considered, so equal distances keep the first one scanned and enemies up to the running maximum are skipped afterwards. When such an enemy is found the running cell maximum is reset to 0 and its free adjacent cells (getAdjacentCells order) are compared by distance from the caster, the first strictly farther one winning; selectedCell is replaced only when that enemy has at least one free adjacent cell. If it has none, selectedCell is NOT cleared and keeps the cell chosen for an earlier, nearer enemy, whose enemy then counts as the target of the destination. The fallback (the free cell closest by Manhattan distance to the farthest enemy found, anywhere on the board, which may not be adjacent) runs only if selectedCell is still null at the end. Pinned-helper probe on a 6-row x 8-column board, caster (0,0): near enemy (2,0), far enemy (7,5) boxed in by three allies -> destination (3,1) next to the NEAR enemy; far enemy with a free neighbour -> destination (7,4) next to the far enemy; far enemy as the only enemy and boxed in -> fallback cell (7,3). If it returns null (no targettable enemy or no free cell) the caster does not move and only the cast target is hit.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP and adds the five buffs again (they stack within the fight, subject to the speed and floor clamps), then dashes and hits again.
record.rawVsResolved: Buffs: requested +1/+1/+1/+10 speed/+10 AP, applied after Big Eater Belt (x1.25 down), Bandanna conversion, clamps. Damage: raw 40 (MASQUERAIN) / 80 (BEAUTIFLY) x (1 + AP/100, AP including the +10 gained in this cast) [x crit], then special-defense division (ceil, min 1) and shields in handleDamage; takenDamage counts shield damage.
